placements.link_name: Hormuz bypass pipelines and Red Sea and Gulf of Oman terminals
placements.role: Holder of a disclosed interest in Vopak Horizon Fujairah Ltd., a storage terminal at the Port of Fujairah, which is the Gulf of Oman discharge point of the Abu Dhabi Crude Oil Pipeline bypass.

role_evidence.claim: Vopak's own annual report lists Vopak Horizon Fujairah Ltd. at 33.33% among its participating interests in the United Arab Emirates.
role_evidence.source_name: Vopak Annual Report 2025, participating interests in group companies, joint ventures and associates

role_evidence.claim: The Abu Dhabi Crude Oil Pipeline runs from Habshan to Fujairah on the Gulf of Oman side of the country and is the only major bypass that exits the Gulf directly into the Indian Ocean.
role_evidence.source_name: The Conversation, What alternatives do Gulf states have to the Strait of Hormuz?

placements.role: Operates methanol-bunkering-enabled storage terminal infrastructure: ran the world's first barge-to-ship methanol bunkering operation at its Vopak Terminal Botlek (Port of Rotterdam), and opened an ISCC EU-certified green-methanol import corridor from its Tianjin Lingang terminal in China to its Penjuru terminal in Singapore.

role_evidence.claim: Waterfront Shipping, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Methanex, demonstrated the launch of the world's first barge-to-ship methanol bunkering operation at the Vopak Terminal Botlek of Royal Vopak, at the Port of Rotterdam.
role_evidence.source_name: Royal Vopak, NEWS: first barge-to-ship methanol bunkering operation in the world

role_evidence.claim: ISCC EU-certified green methanol is loaded at Vopak's Tianjin Lingang terminal in China and received at the Vopak Penjuru terminal in Singapore, where it is stored ready for bunkering.
role_evidence.source_name: Bunker Market, Vopak and Global Energy Forge Green Methanol Corridor: Tianjin to Singapore
